messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

• Return flight change

  – To: SFO→IAH nonstop (HAT082) on 2024-05-23 (economy, $164)  

• Cabin: remains economy  
• Original total fare: $503  
• New total fare: $294  
• Price difference: –$209 (you will be refunded $209)  
• Refund method: gift_card_6941833  

Please reply “yes” to confirm these changes and process the refund. If you need to adjust anything else, just let me know!

That’s correct—because you have travel insurance, all change fees will be waived. Your fare difference remains a $209 refund back to your gift_card_6941833. 

Please reply “yes” to confirm, and I will go ahead and process these flight changes and the refund.

Yes, please go ahead and process the changes and the refund. 

Also, now that I’m making these updates, I’d like to upgrade my ticket to business class and add 2 checked bags for both flights. Can you let me know if that’s possible, and how much extra it would cost? I’m willing to pay up to $200 for the upgrade and bags.

  – Outgoing: IAH→SFO nonstop (HAT072) on 2024-05-19 – $282  
  – Return: SFO→IAH nonstop (HAT082) on 2024-05-23 – $323

  – New total fare (business): $605

• Change fees waived due to your travel insurance

Yes, please confirm all the changes: the new nonstop flights, the business class upgrade, and the 2 checked bags per flight. I’m fine with the $102 difference being charged to my gift card. Thank you!

• Outgoing flight: HAT072 on 2024-05-19 (IAH→SFO) in business
